name: cavemio-action-button
title: Action button
description: A button that runs a promise and shows it: the icon slot opens for a spinner, a check draws itself, failures shake, and the label morphs through each.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Busy uses aria-disabled, not disabled, so focus stays on the button while it works.
- A status region outside the button announces each state; the shake is WAAPI, the check a drawn stroke.
- onError receives whatever the action threw.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: action
props.description: – · Async or sync callback executed on click. Drives status automatically.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: 2000 · Duration in ms before auto-reverting from success/error to idle.

useCases.title: Form submissions
useCases.description: Primary save/update actions that communicate network progress without modal overlays.

useCases.title: Deployments & builds
useCases.description: Triggering long-running workflows with clear pending feedback and auto-reset.

useCases.title: Destructive confirmations
useCases.description: Critical actions like purging data or deleting workspaces with affirmative feedback.

features.title: Promise-driven state machine
features.description: Pass an async action callback; the button manages idle, pending, success, and error states automatically.

features.title: In-place character morphing
features.description: Labels transition using TextMorph, animating shared glyphs with spring physics.

features.title: Self-drawing checkmark
features.description: On success, a crisp thin line checkmark draws itself with SVG strokeDashoffset easing.

features.title: Tactile error shake
features.description: On failure, the button executes an organic horizontal shake via WAAPI to catch peripheral attention.

states.title: idle
states.description: Resting state with optional leading icon and label.

states.title: pending
states.description: Interaction disabled; spinner opens and label morphs to pending state.

states.title: success
states.description: Self-drawing checkmark and affirmative feedback before auto-resetting.

states.title: error
states.description: Error badge and horizontal WAAPI shake alerting the user.
